tha-ap503:1.3: sambuddho himavantamupāgamiṁ ajjhogayha himavantaṁ → bhagavā himavantamupāgami ajjhogahetvā hivavantaṁ (bj)
tha-ap503:1.4: himavantamupāgamiṁ ajjhogayha → himavantaṁ upāgami ajjhogahetvā (sya-all);  (pts) | himavantamupāgami → mupāgamiṁ (bj: machasaṁ)

tha-ap503:12.4: bibbohanasamāyutaṁ → bimbohanasamāyutaṁ (cck) | bimbohanasamāyutaṁ → bibbohanasamāyutaṁ… (cck: syā. ka.)
